description: Import the contacts, as the dry run at `revision` said. All or nothing: every row lands, or none does. Committing again at the same revision answers the same result and writes nothing, so a retry is safe. Everything is checked again first: 402 when the new contacts would pass your plan's limit, 409 serverErrors.labelLimit when the label is new and the workspace has no room for it, 409 serverErrors.importBlocked (`params.blocker`) when no column holds the address or every row failed, 409 serverErrors.importStale after a change, and 409 serverErrors.importExpired when it was left open too long. Anyone the file marks Do not email goes on the suppression list. The address of each contact the file creates is checked when you hold the validate permission and address checks are turned on (get_email_check_setup); one already here keeps its verdict, and so does one your file marked invalid. `checks` says how many checks started, or why none did, and `checkAddresses: false` skips them. Checks never refuse the write: when this month's address checks are used up, the workspace's last payment didn't go through, or our team suspended the workspace, the contacts are saved and their checks wait on hold until the 1st of next month or the plan has room (`workspace_limit`), until the payment goes through (`payment_failed`), or until the suspension is lifted (`workspace_suspended`). A big file can take over a minute: wait up to 2 minutes for the answer. The SDK does this on its own.

checkAddresses.description: Check the address of each contact the file creates. A contact already here keeps its verdict and gets no new check. `checks` in the answer says how many started, or why none did. True by default. It needs the validate permission and address checks turned on (get_email_check_setup). Without either, nothing is checked. If this month's address checks are used up, what you sent is still saved. The checks wait on hold until the 1st of next month or until the plan has room.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

revision.description: The revision whose dry run you read. If the settings changed since, nothing is imported and it answers 409 serverErrors.importStale.
